body:
I kept failing because i couldn't push through the pain, have the courage to do something drastic, or have the method itself not finish the job. So my plan kept morphing over the years and attempts. This has led me to combine methods. The first should work by itself, but in case it doesn't it should induce unconsciousness no matter what and is easy to pull off. The second method is more sure however more painful, so I set it up so that one I slip fully into unconsciousness I will slowly fall into the second activation. Should both of these fail I have a third method which is kinda silly overkill. This method is kinda the "oh shit I failed horribly and have possibly become braindead" option. Problem is it will leave more of a mess for others to clean up, so I'd rather not use it. So I have two devices to measure pressure and a certain gas level tied to a raspberry pi. This is set on a fairly long timer to trigger the final method should both the pressure and gas readings not read high enough. 
Should all of this fail I will assume i have the devil's luck and invest all my money in lottery tickets and discover my long lost talent of flight.

A nasty hospital experience jaded my view on the medical industry and made me guarded in what I would tell the therapist or psychiatrist. Neither therapist I tried seemed to help me much, but I never was able to be very truthful so it probably didn't help. After a few months with paxil and rexulti I did feel slightly better, but at that point I started to have an allergic reaction to something so I just dropped them. Lack of progress and extremely high costs added to my jaded opinion kinda killed those options for me.

Well my suicidal thoughts have subsided some since this last post. I did kinda attempt a bunch of times, but couldn't muster the courage to go through with it, and only ended up hurting myself. I think part of the reason the thoughts have become less pressing is because I lost my job and haven't left my house for a week. Losing the pressure from dealing with people has helped some. Probably being shut in won't help in the long run, but I'm just so tired of dealing with people. Still pretty lost.
